title: Reproduction materials: Goodness of fit for logistic regression with many groups: a score-test correction of the Hosmer-Lemeshow test
description: Code, pre-registration declarations and per-replication simulation results reproducing every table and figure of the paper 'Goodness of fit for logistic regression with many groups: a score-test correction of the Hosmer-Lemeshow test' (Ebrahim, Khattab and El-Kotory, 2026) and its Online Resource 1. Folder paper_2026/ holds the 2026 paper; the earlier materials (v1.0.0) are kept at the repository root. The test is implemented in the CRAN package ebrahim.gof.
